newsitem.title: TAIWAN: BADMINTON-OLYMPIC CHAMPION BEATEN BY FELLOW DANE.
newsitem.headline: BADMINTON-OLYMPIC CHAMPION BEATEN BY FELLOW DANE.

text.p: Olympic champion Poul-Erik Hoyer-Larsen suffered a surprise defeat in the final of the Chinese Taipei badminton Open championship on Sunday, losing to fellow Dane Peter Gade-Christensen who triumphed 15-10 18-15.
In the semifinal, Gade-Christensen, the joint fifth seed, had beaten top seed Fung Permadi of Taiwan.
The women's singles final went to second-seed Camilla Martin of Denmark who upset top seed Mia Audina of Indonesia 12-10 11-2.
